name: Mayfair, Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments
short_description: Long-stay serviced apartments on Langsuan Road in central Bangkok, a short walk from Lumphini Park and Chit Lom BTS, offering one- to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens.
ai_summary: Mayfair, Bangkok is a Marriott Executive Apartments property, a long-stay serviced-apartment format aimed at families and relocating professionals rather than short-break tourists. Set on quiet Soi Langsuan in Pathum Wan, it sits within a 7-10 minute walk of Chit Lom BTS, Ratchadamri BTS and Lumphini Park, with Central Chidlom and CentralWorld shopping close by. The 162 units span one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments roughly 54-186 sqm, each with a fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, work desk and separate living and dining areas. A 25th-floor saltwater rooftop pool with a pool bar, a 24-hour fitness centre, spa, kids' area and the Bistro M restaurant round out the amenities. Independent reviews and TripAdvisor feedback (rated around 4.5/5 and consistently ranking among Bangkok's better-reviewed stays) repeatedly praise spacious, well-serviced apartments, warm and attentive front-desk staff, and strong value for extended stays. Common watchouts are dated decor in some units, uninspiring city-office views from lower floors, and the loyalty caveat that Executive Apartments earn reduced Marriott Bonvoy points and night credits versus standard hotels. Overall it reads as a reliable, homely base for anyone spending a week or more in central Bangkok.

faqs.question: Is Mayfair, Bangkok a hotel or a serviced apartment?
faqs.answer: It is a Marriott Executive Apartments property, meaning long-stay serviced apartments with full kitchens, washer/dryers and living areas, backed by hotel-style services such as housekeeping, a front desk, a pool and a fitness centre.

faqs.question: How far is it from the BTS Skytrain and Lumphini Park?
faqs.answer: The apartments sit on Langsuan Road, roughly a 7-10 minute walk from Chit Lom and Ratchadamri BTS stations and about the same walk to Lumphini Park, with Central Chidlom and CentralWorld shopping nearby.

faqs.question: What apartment sizes are available?
faqs.answer: One-, two- and three-bedroom apartments ranging roughly from 54 to about 186 square metres, each with a fully equipped kitchen, dedicated work area and multiple bathrooms in the larger layouts.

reviews.title: Mayfair, Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments Review: What To REALLY Expect If You Stay
reviews.summary: Independent review site rates it a strong pick for families wanting serviced apartments with hotel amenities: rooftop saltwater pool, roomy kitchens, gym and kids' club. Flags dated decor and Wi-Fi fees for non-members.

reviews.title: [Accommodation Review] - Mayfair Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments (2 Bedroom Suite)
reviews.author: kktong76
reviews.summary: Blogger review of a spacious 100 sqm two-bedroom suite with full kitchen and quality bedding. Praises warm service, varied breakfast and the 25th-floor pool; downsides: odd master-bedroom TV placement, office outlook and a walk to the BTS.

reviews.title: Mayfair, Bangkok - Marriott Executive Apartments
reviews.summary: Lifestyle feature on the central-yet-quiet Langsuan setting near the BTS and nightlife: a saltwater rooftop pool, spacious one-bedroom suites with leather sofas and full kitchens, plus casual dining at Bistro M and the Sky Pool Bar.
